reviewer: claude-opus-5 acting as the joshi pump-discovery deputy, autonomously, without Ember present
rationale: REFUSED for the same measured reason as discovery_coins, and refused independently rather than by inheritance. The shape above is the exact structural signature of one real acquisition (acq:pump-api:aa47977575a5c7fab82dae8476b1df1a:1787368676504083-4489ef8675789117a90c41a1c6d49e91, GET /coins/currently-live?limit=5, 2026-08-22T03:19Z, HTTP 200, five rows). The document is a BARE top-level JSON array. Rows are the /coins coin record plus a livestream block: num_participants, livestream_title, thumbnail, thumbnail_updated_at, playlist_status, playlist_updated_at, playlist_url, playlist_url_high, playlist_url_low and vod_playlist_url. WHY REFUSED: the rows are heterogeneous exactly as on /coins, and worse. In one sixty-row read, base_decimals appeared on 42 rows, quote_mint on 42, pool_address on 43, quote_decimals on 50, token_program on 54, livestream_title on 58, and ath_market_cap, ath_market_cap_timestamp, market_cap_usd, market_cap_quote and last_trade_timestamp on 59 of 60. The whole-document fingerprint is therefore a function of which sixty streamers happened to be live, and pinning one is meaningless. Only num_participants, usd_market_cap and the identity fields were on all sixty. MEASURED ORDERING, WHICH IS THE POINT OF THIS ROUTE AND IS NOT OBSERVABLE: the sixty rows are not sorted by num_participants, not by usd_market_cap and not by last_trade_timestamp, in either direction. Whatever ranks this feed is not a field the feed returns, so row position here is not a readable rank and nothing downstream may treat it as one. offset and limit were both honoured; offset=30 returned the rows that a bare read had at positions 30 to 39, modulo the feed moving underneath. UNITS HAZARD as on /coins: updated_at is epoch seconds while created_timestamp, last_trade_timestamp, ath_market_cap_timestamp, last_reply and thumbnail_updated_at are epoch milliseconds. num_participants is the only audience-size number in this catalog and ranged 0 to 12 across the read. This review was made by an agent, not by Ember. It authorises nothing. SUPERSEDED, NOT ABANDONED: this route is now governed by the row-projection review review:pump-currently-live-rows:2026-08-22:v1, which reviews a required leaf set and a closed optional leaf set PER ROW over exactly the projection the normalizer reads. This document-level refusal stands and is kept deliberately: it is the record of why one digest over a whole page cannot gate a heterogeneous-row collection, and the observed fingerprint is still recorded on every row-projection decision as a drift signal.
